sentences.sentence: I would feel so happy to have a magic wand.
I would always use a magic wand when I take the test.
I sometimes forget to write my name on my test paper.
I would never do poorly on a test.
I would use a magic wand to easily clean my room.
It wasn't very hard to find the exit.
I think riding roller coasters is really fun.
Interestingly, the best part would be helping my friends.
